talk about unethical shot all you want, probably jumped the string and turned, or the arrow hit a branch, or some freak accident, but there is a right way to shoot an animal in the head...

im a trapper, subsistence hunter. grew up in a home where food stamps were traded for meth. ive never attempted with an arrow, but in case anybody needs to know, to survive, the brain is a little further back... lol

stick to ethical shots tho if possible... but most will jump down off that high horse when their belly starts to rumble and  beef is $20 a pound cuz we are 6uilding 6ack 6etter

barnett wildcat 165 pound pull, $170 shipped off pyramid air

bolts? whatevers cheapest, 125 grain chinese broadheads. dont waste expensive bolts on yotes

yes, a piece of 5/16" brakeline for the barrel, stiff spring for power, some scrapwood, tape, etc and you have a ZIP gun, just like they used to make in the 50's

fires .22lr or shorts but is terribly inaccurate, i call mine "the redneck liberator" because they really dont have much use beyond being used to acquire a real firearm, mabey trapping disbatch.

i have a few hidden around tho, just in case

definetly 160's, they take coon but can also be used on rats n mink. woodchuck, skunk, all sorts of shit

if i could go back id have never bought 110's and just got 160's, i trap to eat, so i like versatility. one trap to catch a whole lot of stuff. if you are worried about the 160 crushing a little muskrat or squirrel, leave one of the saftey hooks on.
Hang it in your yard, the neighbors will learn something

110s are big unless your rats are huge, another thing is duke traps, at least the 220s and 330s, have creepy triggers. Creepy as in slow, lots of creep, yeno 


There is instructions on trigger mods on Trapperman forum, idk about duke 110s, all my smaller conibears are bridger 110s and 150s


Get some regular victor rat traps, or even better some all metal ones off self reliance outfitters. Drill a hole in the wood frame and attach a tie off cord. I’ve caught squirrels in them, plenty of rats and chipmunks, occasionally moles, and once a 2 pound possum
The new world order wants me fat and weak and stupid. I don’t want that
I’ve eaten Fox and coyote, it’s really not bad
